veranderings.na: oor die huis wat ver weg is
veranderings.rede: The bare postposed 'ver weg' reads clipped and poetic; a relative clause is clearer at Grade 6.

veranderings.voor: Isicathamiya is 'n hele koor met net stemme en 'n voorsanger.
veranderings.na: In isicathamiya sing 'n hele koor en 'n voorsanger met net hul stemme.
veranderings.rede: A music style is not a choir, and 'net stemme en 'n voorsanger' wrongly sets the lead singer apart from the voices; this also matches the next sentence's 'In maskandi speel...'.

veranderings.voor: Praat net so eerlik en met respek oor 'n ander groep se optrede.
veranderings.na: Praat net so eerlik en met respek oor 'n ander groep se optrede as oor julle s'n.
veranderings.rede: 'Net so' sets up a comparison that is never completed; naming the other half makes the sentence say what it means.
AWS 2017: no comma before 'en' when it joins two phrases rather than two clauses with their own subject and verb.
